subject: zoology_2
question_text: It is true that 'MTP is not meant for population control'. Then why did the Government of India legalize MTP?

page_header: Section A — Very Short Answer Question

steps.label: What MTP is
steps.why: The question turns on what MTP is for, so the full name has to come first.
common_mistakes: Writing that it is a contraceptive method. It is not.
steps.memory_tip: MTP means Medical Termination of Pregnancy.
steps.margin_note: Expand the abbreviation, then give the reasons.
lines: MTP means Medical Termination of Pregnancy.
It is legalised in India with some

steps.label: Why it was legalised
steps.why: It exists to protect the woman, not to control numbers, which is exactly what the question is testing.
common_mistakes: Giving population control as a reason. The question says it is not one.
Naming only one of the three cases.
steps.memory_tip: Unwanted pregnancy, rape, and danger to the mother.
steps.margin_note: Three numbered cases complete the answer.
lines: It is allowed to deal with:

lines.text: 3. Danger to the mother from the pregnancy

insider_note: Expand MTP in the first line. The three reasons that follow are the answer, and each is a separate tick.
